description:
Cast Pirated Copy by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Princess Yue.
Put Pirated Copy into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Pirated Copy dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield as a land named Moon. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Wormfang Turtle, gaining its abilities.
When Pirated Copy enters, its first ability triggers, exiling it.
When Pirated Copy leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Pirated Copy from exile to the battlefield. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Princess Yue.
Repeat from step 2.
